title: Stalk of the etale inverse image of a sheaf of sets, with germs
statement: Let $e:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $G$ a sheaf of sets on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Let $e^{-1}G$ be its etale inverse image (a sheaf of sets on $T_{\Et}$) and, for an object $U$ of $S_{\Et}$ and $a\in G(U)$, let $e^*a\in(e^{-1}G)(U\times_ST)$ be the image of $a$ under the unit $G\to e_*e^{-1}G$, both as in [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Let $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $\bar s=e\circ\bar t$; stalks, pointed etale neighbourhoods and germs are those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For a pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u)$ of $\bar s$, the pair $(U\times_ST,(\bar u,\bar t))$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is a pointed etale neighbourhood of $\bar t$. Then there is exactly one map of sets $c_{e,\bar t,G}:(e^{-1}G)_{\bar t}\to G_{\bar s}$ such that for every pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u)$ of $\bar s$ and every $a\in G(U)$\n$$c_{e,\bar t,G}\bigl(\text{germ of }e^*a\text{ at }(U\times_ST,(\bar u,\bar t))\bigr)=\text{germ of }a\text{ at }(U,\bar u),$$\nand $c_{e,\bar t,G}$ is bijective.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback) (3), for sheaves of sets, with the compatibility with germs of pulled-back sections made explicit (the abelian version is lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ)

proof.text: Use the general-site route cited in Stacks 03Q1 (3), via Sites 05V1. For Type (u+1), compose the inverse of Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullbackIso, the inverse of Point.sheafFiberComapIso, and Point.sheafFiberIso (Scheme.pointSmallEtaleComapIso e t). All three are proved library isomorphisms. The construction is exactly Scheme.etaleSetPullback, and its component at G is a bijection of the stalks. The geometric point comparison is the universal property of base change.

Compose the germ equality with the inverse comparison and expand its factors. Point.toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberIso_inv_app transports the pointed neighbourhood; Point.toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberComapIso_hom_app then gives the abstract sheaf-pullback unit followed by the germ. Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality moves the constructed/abstract comparison past the germ, and Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app evaluated at U gives the constructed adjunction unit. These are existing proved rewrite lemmas; associativity finishes the morphism equality.

The transported pointed lift is the explicit Over.homMk (pullback.lift x.left t (Over.w x)) in the statement: apply Over.OverMorphism.ext and pullback.hom_ext, and use Scheme.pointSmallEtaleFiberEtaleIso_inv_app_left_fst and _snd with pullback.lift_fst and _snd. Evaluate the preceding morphism equality on a to obtain the germ formula.

For an arbitrary inverse-image stalk element z, use Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective to represent its image under the comparison as the germ of a section a at a pointed neighbourhood (U,x) of t >> e. The germ formula says the corresponding pulled-back germ has the same image as z, so injectivity of the comparison identifies them. Any map d satisfying the germ formula therefore agrees with the comparison at z. Function extensionality proves uniqueness; ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso proves bijectivity.
